definition: An assessment of climate or disaster risk to infrastructure or facilities, carried out, financed or required by this project: a site-specific assessment or screening of the works and sites it finances, a sector-wide or national assessment of existing infrastructure, an assessment that operators, contractors or bidders must carry out, or hazard and risk mapping used to decide where infrastructure goes. Hazards include floods, storms and cyclones, sea level rise, heat, drought, landslides and earthquakes.
note: Deliberately silent on digital assets: the asset link is computed separately (the asset map), because the decision model reads a question literally and does not infer that a tower is digital infrastructure.
